exposure: jaundice on day two of life
cohort: Term, healthy infants admitted to the newborn unit postdelivery
finding: Earlier gestational age, jaundice on day two of life, and maternal group B streptococcus chemoprophylaxis were associated with readmission, while cesarean delivery and formula feeding were protective.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a lower risk of neonatal readmission.
